body:
Ingestion Service API Raw spec: /openapi.yaml
Ingestion, record queries and asynchronous CSV processing. Check /readyz before sending requests; available capabilities depend on the selected runtime.
Ingestion Service API Raw spec: /openapi.yaml Swagger UI: /docs

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Ingestion Service API
  version: 0.1.0
  description: |-
    Standalone ingestion service for the new fraud platform.

    Current implementation status:
    - health and readiness endpoints
    - service auth middleware
    - upstream data-model-service contract client
    - single-record ingest endpoints
    - batch ingest endpoints
    - CSV upload endpoint
    - upload-log read endpoints
    - payload validation against the published data model
    - patch semantics
    - direct writes into tenant schemas
    - ingestion audit persistence
    - durable outbox-event persistence
    - idempotent response replay for repeated successful requests
    - bounded CSV retry handling with terminal failure after max attempts

    Remaining planned work:
    - monitoring and scoring consumers
    - dead-letter or quarantine flow for permanently failed CSV jobs
tags:
  - name: Health
    description: Liveness and readiness endpoints for service monitoring.
  - name: Tenant Ingestion
    description: Tenant-scoped record ingestion endpoints.
  - name: Tenant Queries
    description: Tenant-scoped record lookup and aggregate query endpoints.
  - name: Upload Logs
    description: CSV upload and upload-log inspection endpoints.
  - name: Deferred Ingest
    description: Deferred ingest execution inspection and backlog monitoring endpoints.
paths:
  /healthz:
    get:
      tags: [Health]
      summary: Liveness probe
      description: |-
        Lightweight process liveness check.

        Use this to confirm the HTTP service is running. It does not verify database connectivity or
        prove that the service is ready to execute ingestion work.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is alive
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/StatusResponse'
  /readyz:
    get:
      tags: [Health]
      summary: Readiness probe
      description: |-
        Dependency-aware readiness check.

        Use this before routing traffic to the service. A successful response means the service can
        reach its configured database dependency and is ready to handle requests.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is ready
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/StatusResponse'
        '503':
          description: Database is unavailable
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ReadyErrorResponse'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/ingest/{objectType}:
    post:
      tags: [Tenant Ingestion]
      summary: Ingest one record
      description: |-
        Creates or updates one tenant-scoped record through the published ingestion contract.

        The payload is validated against the current `data-model-service` contract for the tenant and
        object type. Full-write semantics apply here, so required fields are enforced and `object_id`
        must be present.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ObjectType'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: true
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Record ingested
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  result:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/IngestResult'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Conflict'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationFailed'
        '202':
          description: Record queued for deferred ingest because the synchronous write path was saturated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  deferred_ingest:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/DeferredIngest'
    patch:
      tags: [Tenant Ingestion]
      summary: Patch one record
      description: |-
        Partially updates one tenant-scoped record.

        This uses patch semantics rather than full-write semantics. `object_id` is still required so
        the service can locate the target record, but only the supplied fields are validated and applied.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ObjectType'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: true
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Record patched
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  result:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/IngestResult'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Conflict'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationFailed'
        '202':
          description: Record patch queued for deferred ingest because the synchronous write path was saturated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  deferred_ingest:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/DeferredIngest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/ingest/{objectType}/batch:
    post:
      tags: [Tenant Ingestion]
      summary: Ingest a batch of records
      description: |-
        Ingests multiple records of the same object type in one synchronous request.

        Each row is validated against the tenant's published contract. This is the direct batch form of
        the single-record ingest flow and is intended for callers that already have records in JSON form
        rather than CSV.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ObjectType'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: array
              items:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: true
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Batch ingested
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  results:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/IngestResult'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Conflict'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationFailed'
    patch:
      tags: [Tenant Ingestion]
      summary: Patch a batch of records
      description: |-
        Partially updates multiple records of the same object type in one synchronous request.

        This is the batch form of patch ingestion. Each record must still identify its target with
        `object_id`, but only the supplied fields are validated and applied.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ObjectType'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: array
              items:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: true
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Batch patched
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  results:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/IngestResult'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Conflict'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationFailed'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/records/{objectType}:
    get:
      tags: [Tenant Queries]
      summary: List records for one object type
      description: |-
        Returns records for one tenant object type.

        Use this for simple record browsing or lightweight lookups when you already know the object
        type and just need a bounded list of records.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ObjectType'
        - name: limit
          in: query
          description: Maximum number of records to return. If omitted, the service uses its default limit.
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Record list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/RecordListResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/records/{objectType}/search:
    get:
      tags: [Tenant Queries]
      summary: Search records by one field value
      description: |-
        Returns records for one object type that match a single field/value lookup.

        This is a simple query endpoint for exact field matching rather than a broad search surface.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ObjectType'
        - name: field
          in: query
          required: true
          description: Field name to match within the target object type.
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: value
          in: query
          required: true
          description: Field value to match.
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: limit
          in: query
          description: Maximum number of matching records to return. If omitted, the service uses its default limit.
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Matching record list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/RecordListResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/records/{objectType}/{objectId}:
    get:
      tags: [Tenant Queries]
      summary: Get one record by object id
      description: |-
        Returns one tenant record by object type and object id.

        Use this when you already know the record identifier and want the stored field values back.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ObjectType'
        - name: objectId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: External record identifier used as the tenant-scoped lookup key.
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Record
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/RecordResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/ingest/{objectType}/csv:
    post:
      tags: [Upload Logs]
      summary: Upload a CSV file for asynchronous ingestion
      description: |-
        Uploads a CSV file for worker-driven asynchronous ingestion.

        The API stores the upload and creates an upload-log record immediately, then the background
        worker claims the uploaded file and processes rows through the same validation and write path
        used by batch ingestion.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ObjectType'
        - name: mode
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [create, patch]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                file:
                  type: string
                  format: binary
              required: [file]
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Upload accepted
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  upload_log:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/UploadLog'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/ingest/{objectType}/upload-logs:
    get:
      tags: [Upload Logs]
      summary: List upload logs for one tenant/object type
      description: |-
        Lists CSV upload logs for one tenant and object type.

        Use this to inspect asynchronous ingestion progress, including whether uploads are still queued,
        currently processing, completed successfully, or failed.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ObjectType'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Upload-log list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  upload_logs:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/UploadLog'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/query/aggregate:
    post:
      tags: [Tenant Queries]
      summary: Execute a tenant-scoped aggregate query
      description: |-
        Executes a constrained aggregate query inside the tenant schema.

        This endpoint exists primarily for decision-time aggregate pushdown from `decision-engine-service`.
        It validates the object type, field names, aggregate, and filter structure against the published
        tenant model and returns only the aggregate result.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AggregateQueryRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Aggregate result
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AggregateQueryResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/upload-logs/{uploadLogId}:
    get:
      tags: [Upload Logs]
      summary: Get one upload log
      description: |-
        Returns one upload-log record by id.

        Use this to poll the detailed state of a previously uploaded CSV job, including row counts,
        attempt counts, terminal failure details, and current processing status.
      parameters:
        - name: uploadLogId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Upload log
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  upload_log:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/UploadLog'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/deferred-ingests/{deferredIngestId}:
    get:
      tags: [Deferred Ingest]
      summary: Get one deferred ingest execution
      description: |-
        Returns one deferred ingest execution by id.

        Use this to poll the state of a single-record ingest request that was accepted with `202`
        because the synchronous write path was saturated. A deferred ingest remains queued until a
        worker claims it, processes it through the normal ingest service path, and marks it as
        completed or failed.
      parameters:
        - name: deferredIngestId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Deferred ingest execution
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  deferred_ingest:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/DeferredIngest'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/admin/deferred-ingest-metrics:
    get:
      tags: [Deferred Ingest]
      summary: Get deferred ingest backlog and drain metrics
      description: |-
        Returns a database-backed snapshot of deferred ingest backlog and recent worker outcomes.

        These metrics are intended to show whether overflowed single-record ingests are piling up
        or draining successfully after the API falls back to asynchronous worker processing.

        In the MySQL runtime this snapshot covers the configured tenant and table only;
        query parameters cannot select another scope. Each resource's current job is counted
        once, including after redrive. Cancelled jobs use the existing failed resource status.
        Retry metrics count executions, matching the existing PostgreSQL response contract.
        More than 10,000 retained deferred resources in that scope returns 413 rather than
        partial totals. Snapshot time is read from the database and recent counts use five minutes.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Deferred ingest metrics snapshot
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  deferred_ingest_metrics:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/DeferredIngestMetrics'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid service credential in authenticated mode
        '403':
          description: Current tenant or table authority is unavailable
        '413':
          description: Exact snapshot exceeds the configured retained-resource bound
        '503':
          description: Storage, grants or current-job lineage is unavailable
        '504':
          description: Metrics snapshot exceeded its five-second deadline
components:
  parameters:
    TenantId:
      name: tenantId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Tenant identifier. This must match a tenant known to `data-model-service`.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    ObjectType:
      name: objectType
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Logical object type to ingest or query. In practice this is the tenant data-model table name, such as `transactions`, `accounts`, or `customers`.
      schema:
        type: string
        example: transactions
  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: Bad request
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
    Conflict:
      description: Idempotency conflict
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
    ValidationFailed:
      description: Payload validation failed
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationFailureEnvelope'
  schemas:
    StatusResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
      required: [status]
    ReadyErrorResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
        error:
          type: string
      required: [status, error]
    IngestResult:
      type: object
      description: Result for one ingested record after validation and write processing.
      properties:
        object_id:
          type: string
          description: External record identifier used as the tenant-scoped lookup key for the ingested object.
        action:
          type: string
          enum: [created, updated]
          description: Whether the write created a new record or updated an existing one.
        revision_id:
          type: string
          description: Published data-model revision used to validate this write.
        replayed:
          type: boolean
          description: True when the service replayed a previously successful idempotent response instead of writing again.
      required: [object_id, action, revision_id]
    RecordLookup:
      type: object
      description: Stored tenant record returned by the record lookup endpoints.
      properties:
        object_id:
          type: string
          description: External record identifier used as the tenant-scoped lookup key.
        object_type:
          type: string
          description: Logical object type for the record. This matches the tenant data-model table name.
          example: transactions
        fields:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
          description: Stored field values for the record.
      required: [object_id, object_type, fields]
      example:
        object_id: txn_100234
        object_type: transactions
        fields:
          amount: 12500
          currency: USD
          customer_id: cust_778
    RecordResponse:
      type: object
      description: Envelope for a single record lookup.
      properties:
        record:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/RecordLookup'
      required: [record]
    RecordListResponse:
      type: object
      description: Envelope for a list of records returned by list or search endpoints.
      properties:
        records:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/RecordLookup'
      required: [records]
    ValidationError:
      type: object
      description: Field-level validation failure for one record in an ingest request.
      properties:
        object_id:
          type: string
          description: Record identifier when available. This may be omitted if the payload could not be tied to one object.
        field:
          type: string
          description: Field name that failed validation.
        code:
          type: string
          description: Machine-readable validation code.
        message:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable explanation of the validation failure.
      required: [field, code, message]
    ErrorEnvelope:
      type: object
      properties:
        error:
          type: object
          properties:
            code:
              type: string
            message:
              type: string
          required: [code, message]
      required: [error]
    ValidationFailureEnvelope:
      type: object
      properties:
        error:
          type: object
          properties:
            code:
              type: string
            message:
              type: string
          required: [code, message]
        validation_errors:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationError'
      required: [error, validation_errors]
    UploadLog:
      type: object
      description: Tracked CSV upload and worker-processing state for asynchronous ingestion.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Upload-log identifier.
        tenant_id:
          type: string
          description: Tenant that owns the uploaded CSV job.
        object_type:
          type: string
          description: Target logical object type. This matches the tenant table name used for ingestion.
          example: transactions
        mode:
          type: string
          enum: [create, patch]
          description: Whether CSV rows are processed with full-write semantics or patch semantics.
        filename:
          type: string
          description: Original uploaded filename.
        content_type:
          type: string
          description: Uploaded file content type as received by the API.
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [pending, uploaded, processing, completed, failed]
          description: Current asynchronous processing state for the upload.
        total_rows:
          type: integer
          description: Total number of CSV data rows detected in the upload.
        successful_rows:
          type: integer
          description: Number of rows successfully written so far.
        failed_rows:
          type: integer
          description: Number of rows that failed validation or processing.
        attempt_count:
          type: integer
          description: Number of worker processing attempts made for this upload.
        error_message:
          type: string
          description: Terminal or latest processing error when the upload has failed.
      required: [id, tenant_id, object_type, mode, filename, content_type, status, total_rows, successful_rows, failed_rows, attempt_count]
    DeferredIngest:
      type: object
      description: Deferred single-record ingest execution created when synchronous write admission is saturated.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Deferred ingest execution identifier.
        tenant_id:
          type: string
          description: Tenant that owns the deferred ingest request.
        object_type:
          type: string
          description: Target logical object type. This matches the tenant table name used for ingestion.
          example: transactions
        mode:
          type: string
          enum: [create, patch]
          description: Whether the deferred record will be processed with full-write semantics or patch semantics.
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [queued, processing, completed, failed]
          description: Current asynchronous processing state for the deferred ingest execution.
        attempt_count:
          type: integer
          description: Number of worker processing attempts made for this deferred ingest execution.
        error_message:
          type: string
          description: Terminal or latest processing error when the deferred ingest has failed.
        requested_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Time the deferred ingest execution was created.
        started_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Time a worker most recently started processing this execution.
        completed_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Time the deferred ingest execution completed successfully or failed terminally.
      required: [id, tenant_id, object_type, mode, status, attempt_count, requested_at]
    DeferredIngestMetrics:
      type: object
      description: Database-backed snapshot of deferred ingest backlog, retries, and recent drain behavior.
      properties:
        queued_count:
          type: integer
          description: Number of deferred ingest executions currently waiting to be claimed by a worker.
        processing_count:
          type: integer
          description: Number of deferred ingest executions currently being processed by workers.
        completed_count:
          type: integer
          description: Total number of completed deferred ingest executions retained in the metadata table.
        failed_count:
          type: integer
          description: Total number of terminally failed deferred ingest executions retained in the metadata table.
        retry_pending_count:
          type: integer
          description: Number of queued deferred ingest executions that have already failed at least once and are waiting to retry.
        retried_execution_count:
          type: integer
          description: Number of deferred ingest executions that required more than one processing attempt.
        oldest_queued_requested_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Request time of the oldest currently queued deferred ingest, when one exists.
        oldest_queued_age_seconds:
          type: number
          format: double
          description: Age in seconds of the oldest currently queued deferred ingest.
        recent_success_count:
          type: integer
          description: Number of deferred ingest executions completed in the last five minutes.
        recent_failure_count:
          type: integer
          description: Number of deferred ingest executions that failed terminally in the last five minutes.
        recent_retry_count:
          type: integer
          description: Number of retry attempts started in the last five minutes.
        drain_rate_per_minute_last_5m:
          type: number
          format: double
          description: Average number of completed deferred ingest executions per minute over the last five minutes.
        snapshot_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Time the metrics snapshot was calculated.
      required: [queued_count, processing_count, completed_count, failed_count, retry_pending_count, retried_execution_count, oldest_queued_age_seconds, recent_success_count, recent_failure_count, recent_retry_count, drain_rate_per_minute_last_5m, snapshot_at]
    AggregateQueryRequest:
      type: object
      description: Request for one constrained aggregate query evaluated inside the tenant schema.
      properties:
        object_type:
          type: string
          description: Target logical object type to query. This is the tenant table name from the published data model.
          example: transactions
        aggregate:
          type: string
          enum: [count, count_distinct, sum, avg, min, max]
          description: Aggregate function to execute.
        field:
          type: string
          description: Field to aggregate. For `count`, this is still supplied so the request shape stays uniform.
        filter:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/AggregateFilter'
      required: [object_type, aggregate, field]
    AggregateFilter:
      type: object
      description: Recursive filter tree used to constrain an aggregate query.
      properties:
        kind:
          type: string
          enum: [group, predicate]
          description: Whether this node is a logical group or a leaf predicate.
        operator:
          type: string
          enum: [and, or, not]
          description: Logical operator for group nodes.
        children:
          type: array
          description: Child filter nodes for group expressions.
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AggregateFilter'
        field:
          type: string
          description: Field name used by a predicate node.
        op:
          type: string
          enum: [eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, is_null, is_not_null, starts_with, ends_with]
          description: Predicate operator for a leaf node.
        value:
          description: Comparison value for predicate operators that require one.
    AggregateQueryResponse:
      type: object
      description: Aggregate result returned from a tenant-scoped query.
      properties:
        value:
